notes.title: Second Update: New game+ and something romantic
notes.content:
Second Update: New game+ and some romance...

Good evening everyone. We have already published the second update, which mainly solved the New Game+ problems some players met.
Now you can input a specific name to enter a particular story without accomplish the game first, so you can delete the archived file safely. Of course, there will not be much content...
One character name should be locked, and now it DID.

In addition, Ayako is upset about losing to Princess in the strength of her deck, so she did something romantic to her knife quietly.

Some text errors were fixed, too.

Finally, let's enjoy our new update, and the beautiful moonlight tonight.

notes.title: 1st Update: Bug Fixes and Operational Optimizations
notes.content:
We got a lot of feedback after game released, many of them are really resonable. But we need to apologize about solving them one by one because we don't have enough manpower (only me).
For the first update I'm going to focus on some opertional issues and bug fixes.

Here is the changelog:
- Now you can press SPACE to continue the conversation. We got feedback that clicking the mouse is too tired, this may help you and extend the life of your mouse.
- Now you can click ESC to open settings then click again to close it. Even open, close, open, close... if you like it.
- Fixed the bug that some operations might be reread while pressing SPACE at a specific time.
- Fixed some text errors.

notes.title: To celebrate the official release of In Her Eyes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827748/80545be8f208c129e688c2189d39cfd30d852a3a.png[/img]
Hi, I'm Merlin from Not Dead Luna. Our game will be released soon. I hope that you will have fun in it!

Two things we need to tell you:

Second creation: You are free to recreate anything based on our game with non-commercial use in principle. It will be great if we were informed before doing it.

Dev tools: We have no plan to launch steam workshop any time soon. If you are interested in our storytelling approach and want to use it to create your own story, you are welcome to contact us. We are glad to provide you some simple help.

notes.title: LQA & Bug report
notes.content:
LQA: 
We found some friends to finish our EN and JP localization, so there will be some errors or room for improvement. Please feel free to let us know if you met this. You can leave a message in steam community or write a mail to [noparse]merlin@notdeadluna.com[/noparse], a message with screenshots will be great.

Bug report:
Anyway, we're really sorry for the bug you met. You can also report to us via the same way (steam community & [noparse]merlin@notdeadluna.com[/noparse]). It will help us if you could attach repro steps and your player.log file.
The player.log file is usually in:
Windows: C:/Users/username/AppData/LocalLow/Not Dead Luna/In Her Eyes/
Mac: ~/Library/Logst Dead Luna/In Her Eyes/
We know it's not convenient to do these things. Thanks again for your help.
